lessons.title: Equivalent Circuit Model (ECM) 2-RC Parameter Identification
lessons.summary: Fit open-circuit voltage (OCV-SOC) polynomials and 2-RC resistor-capacitor time constants to HPPC pulse discharge test data with < 1.2% RMSE.
checkpoints: Calculate RC time constant tau1 and tau2 convergence

lessons.title: Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) SOC Estimation under Dynamic WLTP
lessons.summary: Formulate discrete nonlinear state-space equations with state covariance matrix Q and measurement noise R, guaranteeing SOC convergence from 20% initialization error.

lessons.title: Electro-Thermal BTMS Conjugate Heat Transfer Simulation
lessons.summary: Simulate 16-cell series module with Bernardi heat generation, aluminum serpentine cold plate, and 50/50 water-glycol coolant loop dynamics.
checkpoints: Assess pressure drop across channels < 15 kPa

lessons.title: Grid-Forming (GFM) Virtual Synchronous Machine & Islanding Dispatch
lessons.summary: Deploy virtual synchronous generator (VSG) swing equations, active power-frequency droop, and reactive power-voltage droop for zero-inertia microgrid stability.
inputs: Local variable industrial load 4 MW / 1.5 MVAr
checkpoints: Seamless seamless islanding transition within 12 ms
